timeframe: M1 source; M5 strategy bars unless specified

execution_policy.note: No broker order adapter is enabled. Candidate signals are recorded for forward observation only.

candidates.name: RSI14 overbought + bearish M5
candidates.signal: On a completed M5 bar RSI14 >= 70 and the bar closes below its open.
candidates.state_filter: EMA20 > EMA50 and ATR percentile > 67 using prior 120 completed M5 bars
caveats: Historical research figures are not a live result.
Must be independently forward-validated on the live guest feed.

candidates.name: Previous UTC-week low sweep/reclaim
candidates.signal: Completed bullish M5 bar sweeps below the previous completed UTC-week low and closes back above it.
caveats: Validation sample is small and below the 57% review threshold.
Sweep/reclaim wording must be checked against the original research implementation before promotion.

candidates.name: Previous UTC-day low breakdown
candidates.signal: Completed M5 close crosses below the previous completed UTC-day low; previous M5 close was at or above the level.
caveats: Held-out test result is below the 57% review threshold.

candidates.name: EMA20/EMA50 bearish cross
candidates.signal: On a completed M5 bar EMA20 crosses below EMA50 and close is below EMA20.
caveats: Held-out test result is below the 57% review threshold.

candidates.name: NY downside shock rebound
candidates.signal: Completed 18:00–17:00 America/New_York session log return <= -1.0 times mean absolute log return of previous 20 valid sessions.
caveats: Zero eligible forward trades through 2026-11-13; require at least 100 forward trades before review.
Session timezone and completeness checks are mandatory.
